Comments (English): [ Quiet, cleans well, but some quirks ] || ---------------- || Bosch are famous for their silence and cleaning ability, so those aspects were no surprise. It was easy to install, but it seems to have a bit less capacity than the appliance it replaced (or I just haven't mastered the rack/tine flexibility of this model.) I removed one of the two flatware baskets and now place many of the eating utensils on the slightly balky third rack to free up some additional space. With the "Crystal Dry" feature, an internal cache of minerals warms up to 170F when they get wet and this heat facilitates a passive drying cycle. Strangely though Bosch's light, that indicates that the dishwasher is running, goes out at the START of the drying process, so making the assumption that the dishwasher could be unloaded at that time would be wrong -- unless one planned on extensive towel drying of the contents. Overall, I an happy with this product and would recommend it to friends.

Sentence (English): I will confess to being ambivalent about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): I will confess to being ambivalent about this dishwasher. I appreciate the interior lights and the floor status update. It is the quietest dishwasher I have ever owned. It feels solid and I am hopeful that it will be reliable for many years. Still it feels like it needs an ergonomic update. It feels clunky. The handle does not match my Bosch refrigerator which would have been nice. The interior loads fewer dishes and pans than my old Kitchenaid. The racks do not move smoothly. The utensil holder is ridiculously small. And I do not like connecting my appliances with an app. The Kitchenaid was so much more refined than this dishwasher that I will need to manage my expectations. I feel a bit disappointed after reading glowing reviews. Still the dishes come out clean and dry and that is what is expected. It just underwhelms and feels like Bosch could do more on the details that make a product really worth a premium price. Please make the racks roll more smoothly, make the handle standardized to match the refrigerator, redesign the use of interior space and make a much larger utensil holder standard. In short, make this dishwasher feel premium.

The utensil holder is ridiculously small. And I do not like connecting my appliances with an app. The Kitchenaid was so much more refined than this dishwasher that I will need to manage my expectations. I feel a bit disappointed after reading glowing reviews. Still the dishes come out clean and dry and that is what is expected. It just underwhelms and feels like Bosch could do more on the details that make a product really worth a premium price. Comments (English): Installation was fairly straightforward; I watched a video on install which was better tool than the instructions. Luckily the location of the bar and 1 remaining clip are enough to keep it in position and useable. the weight of the silverware also helps. The unit performs very well, is much quieter than I expected and completely dries all dishes. Would recommend purchasing this unit.

I'm actually using it for a while and leaving a review. To conclude, I quite like it. I tend to do a lot of dishwashing at home, and I think the burden has decreased by 70% compared to the past. The remaining 30%, as shown in the picture, are things that need to be cleaned with force, bulky pots, etc. I think cleaning is divided into three parts: temperature, chemistry, and physics, but this dishwasher seems to complete cleaning with temperature (hot water) and chemistry (detergent). So, dishwashing that requires physical force has a very low cleaning power. If you wash those types of dishes in the dishwasher and then dry them, they will dry out even more and create hell, so I recommend just washing them by hand. I had baseless expectations that it would be washed with ultra-high pressure water or something, but when I heard the washing sound, it didn't seem like that. Two more things in the same vein: You can see inside through the glass window, but it's a shame that you can barely see it because there's no lighting. I could only see a little water current, but it didn't seem like ultra-high pressure water. However, it was nice that the cleaning noise, including the engine noise, was lower than expected, so there was no burden even if I turned it on at night. I was aware in advance that water stains would remain, so I wasn't too dissatisfied, but I was more concerned that the rinse aid would remain like residual detergent, so I plan to switch to a product without rinse aid once I've used up the detergent I received. Personally, I think it would be less effective if you placed the bowl at an angle so that the water flows easily, or if you add one rinse. But like the purple baby silicone bowl you see in the picture. In places where water tends to accumulate, it inevitably remains white. There is no space to install a 12-person built-in in a small house, and after installing even a 6-person capacity, there is no space to chop vegetables, and the overall kitchen space has become very cramped, but I am satisfied with being able to get away from washing dishes for a long time. Personally, I have a high level of overall satisfaction, so I would like to organize it later and post it on my personal blog. For reference, I compared several products on my own, but ultimately went to an electronics store to look at the product in advance and chose this product based on a personal recommendation from an employee of another company. Oh, and TMI, I'm an ordinary working male.

Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher Ever ] || ---------------- || I have used many different brands of dishwashers over the years. From low end to high end. This Kitchenaid takes the cake. and whatever else is on your dishes. They come out dry. I have never had a dishwasher where I didn't have to dry or pat everything with a cloth before putting away. The only thing that's held water was my tiny Ninja food processor bowl that has a deep recess on the bottom. This dishwasher cleans everything and doesn't etch my glasses or cause cloudiness. I am using Cascade Platinum Plus because that's the sample that came with the DW and I loved it so much, I decided to purchase it. All my flatware comes out clean. Sentence (English): I have used many different brands of dishwashers over the years.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher Ever ] || ---------------- || I have used many different brands of dishwashers over the years. From low end to high end. This Kitchenaid takes the cake. and whatever else is on your dishes. They come out dry. I have never had a dishwasher where I didn't have to dry or pat everything with a cloth before putting away. The only thing that's held water was my tiny Ninja food processor bowl that has a deep recess on the bottom. This dishwasher cleans everything and doesn't etch my glasses or cause cloudiness. I am using Cascade Platinum Plus because that's the sample that came with the DW and I loved it so much, I decided to purchase it. All my flatware comes out clean. I told my husband that I'm sorry- but I am madly in love with this dishwasher. It's super quiet too which I don't care about but that was also a plus.The only thing I can think of that someone may need to know that's a slight negative- it's depth. It does stick out past my cabinets but NOT past my countertop. The depth is over 24". But I don't care. I had my friends and sisters with newer kitchens send me pics of their installed dishwashers to determine their depth. Depending on the model- this extra depth isn't uncommon. I also love love the top rack. That's where i put my little tiny bowls that I use for ingredients or small servings, my little measuring cups etc. They fit beautifully plus the extra space for utensils is just divine.

I looked there and there. I can't even count how many YouTube videos I've watched of dishwasher reviews. I've come to the conclusion that I have to buy one of the SK and Samsung products! After much deliberation, I decided on the Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-person pink! (<- The pink is my 7-year-old daughter's opinion.) While searching for the lowest price. \"That's right! I was a Coupang Rocket Wow member! I thought to myself, "This is right! I'm a Coupang Rocket Wow member!" When I bought it, it was around 380,000-390,000 won, but thanks to the Rocket Wow member discount, I was able to buy it for around 320,000 won. I told my wife, "I'll buy this!" and placed the order. As expected, Rocket Wow! Delivery is fast and very good~ Size: I ordered this product after looking for a 6-person product for a family of 3, but it is bigger than I thought. Even though I ordered the kitchen size, I felt that it was bigger in real life. I thought about installing it on the island table, but I installed it in the kitchen for the convenience of washing dishes. The interior space felt wider than I thought. Cleaning power: Even though I used the dishes by arranging them in various corners, it felt cleaner and squeakier than when I washed the dishes. I thought that it is not called the 3rd generation kitchen aunt for nothing. I saw that some products can be difficult to wash depending on where the dishes are placed. This product does not seem to have that problem. The door opens automatically after washing the dishes, which was convenient. I think I saw a review somewhere that said that the steam inside escapes and there are no water stains. Other: I thought that even though it is a dishwasher, it is not omnipotent. I thought that I had to do some preliminary washing first and then run the dishwasher to wash the dishes cleanly. For dishes with oil on them, I used a paper towel to remove some of the grease before using the dishwasher. And as with all dishwashers, the operating time is longer than expected. It took 1 hour and 16 minutes when used in standard mode. It would take about 20 minutes if I were to wash the dishes. But I felt like I saved time because I could do other household chores during that 1 hour and 16 minutes. And they say it uses less water than when I wash the dishes. I need to use it more to know for sure, but for now, I like it. I will use it for a month and leave a review again.

I recall seeing a review somewhere that mentioned this prevents water stains because the steam escapes from the interior. Other: I realized that just because it is a dishwasher doesn't mean it's a miracle cure. I concluded that you need to pre-wash the dishes to some extent before running the dishwasher to get them cleaned thoroughly. For greasy dishes, I wiped off some of the grease with a paper towel before using the dishwasher. Also, while I assume all dishwashers are the same, the cycle takes longer than expected. It took 1 hour and 16 minutes on standard mode. It would take me about 20 minutes to wash the dishes by hand, but I felt like I was saving time because I could do other chores during that time. I also heard that it uses less water than when I wash dishes manually. I will need to use it more to know for sure, but for now, I am satisfied. I will leave another review after using it for a month.

Comments (English): [ Make sure to buy a dishwasher. I'm going to buy a robot vacuum cleaner next year. ] || ---------------- || This review is based purely on my personal opinion. I haven't used other products, so I don't know. My wife's opinion isn't included either, as I do most of the dishwashing. My wife asked me to buy her a dishwasher for her birthday, so I browsed here and there. I really don't know how many YouTube videos I watched about dishwasher reviews. I reached the conclusion that I had to buy one of the two: an SK product or a Samsung product! After much deliberation, I decided on the Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-Place Model in pink! (<- Pink was my 7-year-old daughter's choice.) While searching for the lowest price, I suddenly thought, "Right! I'm a Coupang Rocket Wow member!" It hit me like a bolt of lightning, so I logged into Coupang. When I was buying it, it was around 380,000 to 390,000 won, but thanks to the Rocket Wow member discount coupon, I was able to purchase it for around 320,000 won. I told my wife, "I'm buying this!" and placed the order. As expected from Rocket Wow! The delivery was fast, and it's great~. Size: As a family of three, I was looking for a 6-person capacity model and ordered this one, but it is larger than I expected. Even though I measured my kitchen before ordering, the actual product felt bigger than I thought. I considered installing it on the kitchen island, but I decided to install it in the kitchen for dishwashing convenience. The interior space felt more spacious than I anticipated. Cleaning Power: Even though I intentionally spread the dishes out widely into every corner, they felt squeaky clean compared to when I do the washing myself. I realized there is a reason it is called one of the "Top 3 Kitchen Aunties." I have seen reports that with some products, some dishes may not be cleaned properly depending on their placement, but this product does not seem to have that issue. It was convenient that the door opens automatically when the washing is finished. I recall seeing a review somewhere that mentioned this prevents water stains because the steam escapes from the interior. Other: I realized that just because it is a dishwasher doesn't mean it's a miracle cure. I concluded that you need to pre-wash the dishes to some extent before running the dishwasher to get them cleaned thoroughly. For greasy dishes, I wiped off some of the grease with a paper towel before using the dishwasher. Also, while I assume all dishwashers are the same, the cycle takes longer than expected. It took 1 hour and 16 minutes on standard mode. It would take me about 20 minutes to wash the dishes by hand, but I felt like I was saving time because I could do other chores during that time. I also heard that it uses less water than when I wash dishes manually. I will need to use it more to know for sure, but for now, I am satisfied. I will leave another review after using it for a month.

Comments (English): [ Make sure to buy a dishwasher. I'm going to buy a robot vacuum cleaner next year. ] || ---------------- || This review is based purely on my personal opinion. I haven't used other products, so I don't know. My wife's opinion isn't included either, as I do most of the dishwashing. My wife asked me to buy her a dishwasher for her birthday, so I browsed here and there. I really don't know how many YouTube videos I watched about dishwasher reviews. I reached the conclusion that I had to buy one of the two: an SK product or a Samsung product! After much deliberation, I decided on the Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-Place Model in pink! (<- Pink was my 7-year-old daughter's choice.) While searching for the lowest price, I suddenly thought, "Right! I'm a Coupang Rocket Wow member!" It hit me like a bolt of lightning, so I logged into Coupang. When I was buying it, it was around 380,000 to 390,000 won, but thanks to the Rocket Wow member discount coupon, I was able to purchase it for around 320,000 won. I told my wife, "I'm buying this!" and placed the order. As expected from Rocket Wow! The delivery was fast, and it's great~. Size: As a family of three, I was looking for a 6-person capacity model and ordered this one, but it is larger than I expected. Even though I measured my kitchen before ordering, the actual product felt bigger than I thought. I considered installing it on the kitchen island, but I decided to install it in the kitchen for dishwashing convenience. The interior space felt more spacious than I anticipated. Cleaning Power: Even though I intentionally spread the dishes out widely into every corner, they felt squeaky clean compared to when I do the washing myself. I realized there is a reason it is called one of the "Top 3 Kitchen Aunties." I have seen reports that with some products, some dishes may not be cleaned properly depending on their placement, but this product does not seem to have that issue. It was convenient that the door opens automatically when the washing is finished. I recall seeing a review somewhere that mentioned this prevents water stains because the steam escapes from the interior. Other: I realized that just because it is a dishwasher doesn't mean it's a miracle cure. I concluded that you need to pre-wash the dishes to some extent before running the dishwasher to get them cleaned thoroughly. For greasy dishes, I wiped off some of the grease with a paper towel before using the dishwasher. Also, while I assume all dishwashers are the same, the cycle takes longer than expected. It took 1 hour and 16 minutes on standard mode. It would take me about 20 minutes to wash the dishes by hand, but I felt like I was saving time because I could do other chores during that time. I also heard that it uses less water than when I wash dishes manually. I will need to use it more to know for sure, but for now, I am satisfied. I will leave another review after using it for a month.

I was so excited about the features and convenience of this dishwasher, but really with I would have chosen something different. Next time I'll do more research.

Pretty sad that you spend $1400 to get "the best" and this happens (and that it is such a common issue). We were going to get this dishwasher for our Summer home because of the way it stacked and impressive capacity, but not after our experience. I recommend to all to research the pump/filter issue. The fact that supply houses have these pumps in stock (and the filters sold out) tells me all I need to know.

The one positive is it is really quiet.

Sentence (English): My main objective was to get an efficient dishwasher that was as easy to use as possible so I could teach two very elderly people how to use it.

And in fact, this one still seems too complex for the elderly to me. But, at least with this one I have been able to make program selections such that older people who use it only have to press the power button and then the power button for the device to do its job. Displays, smart programs and a million great digital options are all very well, but they prevent older people from having access to them because it is not easy to teach them how to use them. Comments (English): [ Fantastic Machine ] || ---------------- || My wife and I purchased a 300 Series dishwasher for my mother-in-law two years ago who lives on our family's ranch. We had no experience with the Bosch brand other than a fantastic router I had purchased for our shop. The dishwasher had peaked our interest after a conversation with an associate from a local home appliance dealer. That dishwasher is almost undetectable while sitting at the kitchen table after dinner (the drain cycles surprise you because the unit is so quiet). The dishes come out ABSOLUTELY spotless and dry. This experience prompted my wife and I to purchase a Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher after remodeling our own home in September of 2023. We couldn't be happier with our decision. It is very quiet, and in a dry climate such as South Western Montana, the contents of the dishwasher including most plastics are completely dry within 10 minutes after the Auto Air function opens the door. I have never had a more pristine piece of table or tupper ware come out of a dishwasher. The best part is that Bosch's drying technology does not cause fading to the print on our many souvenir pint glasses that we use as daily water vessels. In fact, they have been brought back to their former vibrance (I thought they may have been etched). We are using powder detergent and rinse aid with each cycle, and I have titrated the doses after researching the hardness of the water at our specific location. The Home Connect app even allows one to titrate the amount of rinse aid applied (It can be done on the machine itself with a series of button presses, but is much easier via the app). Prior to your purchase, make sure that you have an outlet handy to plug in the unit, otherwise you will have to purchase the hardwire installation kit. I had enough room to clip the excess romex from my pre-existing hardwire configuration, then simply installed a receptacle with the same wiring for under $10. I would highly recommend this unit.

The driver was blunt, but he did a good job with the installation. You also explained how to use it well. Satisfaction. Most of the pots at home are yellow pots used for boiling ramen, but this one has strange traces left on it, making me wonder if it was washed well. I think you can trust it because it automatically boils cold water to 75 degrees Celsius and does the dishes for you. I think the dishwasher installation was done well. There is a pre-soaking function, but I rarely use it. The reason is because I don’t think it will work out. If it really doesn't work out, I'll have to hang it up again, which will be a hassle. It is always beneficial to buy expensive home appliances when they are on discount.
Comments (Original): [ 구입 한달후기.  무뚝뚝한 기사님이셨으나 설치 잘 해주... ] || ---------------- || 구입 한달후기.  무뚝뚝한 기사님이셨으나 설치 잘 해주고 가셨다. 사용방법도 잘 알려주셧고. 만족.처음엔 엄청 커보였으나 테트리스를 잘 못해서 공간이용을 잘 못한다. 수저통이나 불필요한건 빼버리고 사용중.집에 있는 대부분의 냄비들이 라면 끓일때 쓰는 노랑냄비인데 이건 잘 씻긴건지 의아하게 이상한 흔적이 남아있다.찬물을 75도씨 물로 알아서 끓여서 설겆이를 해주는거니 믿을만 할거 같다. 식세기 설치는 잘 한거 같다. 대충 물로 헹거서 넣어두면 알아서 설겆이를 해주니 시간이 많이 남는다. 소리도 조용해서 새벽에도 돌린다. 혼자쓰기 딱 좋은 6인용. 둘이 써도 적당할듯.처음엔 잘 몰라서 스마트로 문열림을 해뒀더니 열린지 안열린지 모를정도만 살짝 열렸다가 닫히더라. 그런데 스마트를 꺼주니문도 알아서 쫙 열리더라. 스마트가 더 좋아보이기는 하나 불필요한 전기세가 발생하는거 같아서 끄고 사용. 애벌불림 기능이 있지만 궂이 사용하지않는다. 잘 안될거 같아서가 이유다. 진짜 안되면 내가 한번 더 행거줘야 하니 귀찮아질 거 같아서 ㅋ비싼 가전용품들은 할인할때 저렴할때 사는게 모든지 개이득이다.

It turns out that the dishwasher was not properly leveled and the back of the dishwasher was about an inch higher than the front which caused it to dump about a pint of water on the floor in front of the washer. Sentence (English): It has now been a month since our family purchased a Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It has been a month since our family purchased a Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || It has now been a month since our family purchased a Samsung BESPOKE dishwasher. I would like to share a review of this product based on my experience using it. First of all, I was very satisfied with the installation. It was installed the next day after ordering, and the installer was very friendly. Looking at it installed, it goes really well with our kitchen. Needless to say, the design was superb. BESPOKE's design further upgraded the atmosphere of the kitchen. You can choose the color and design you want, so it's tailored to your personal taste. Among the product's features, the most satisfying part was the drying function. Worrying about your plastic dishes getting wet after washing them is a thing of the past. 100 Thanks to the hot air drying function, dishes are dried cleanly without any moisture. As a family with a baby, I find the baby bottle sterilization feature really useful. Thanks to this feature, you can sterilize your baby’s bottles without worry. I also really like the washing course that takes into account Korean eating habits. Even difficult contaminants such as rice paste, red pepper paste, and red pepper powder are easily removed, so there is no inconvenience in using it every day. To summarize my review after one month of use, I think it would be difficult to live without this dishwasher in our household. I highly recommend it to others. This is a really satisfying product!
Comments (Original): [ 저희 가정에서 삼성 BESPOKE 식기세척기를 구매한 지 이제 한 달이... ] || ---------------- || 저희 가정에서 삼성 BESPOKE 식기세척기를 구매한 지 이제 한 달이 지났습니다. 그 동안의 사용 경험을 바탕으로 이 제품에 대한 리뷰를 공유하고자 합니다.먼저 설치부터 매우 만족스러웠습니다. 주문 후 다음날 바로 설치해주셨고, 설치 기사님도 매우 친절하셨습니다. 설치된 모습을 보니 우리 주방과 정말 잘 어울립니다.디자인은 말할 것도 없이 최고였습니다. BESPOKE의 디자인은 주방의 분위기를 한층 업그레이드시켜 주었습니다. 원하는 색상과 디자인을 선택할 수 있어서 개인의 취향에 딱 맞춰져 있습니다.제품의 기능 중에서 가장 만족스러웠던 부분은 건조 기능입니다. 플라스틱 그릇을 세척한 후의 물기 걱정은 이제 과거의 일입니다. 100℃ 열풍 건조 기능 덕분에 그릇은 물기 하나 없이 깨끗하게 건조됩니다.아기가 있는 가정으로서, 젖병 살균 기능도 정말 유용하게 사용하고 있습니다. 이 기능 덕분에 아기 젖병을 걱정 없이 살균하고 있습니다.또한, 한국인의 식습관을 고려한 세척 코스도 정말 마음에 듭니다. 밥풀이나 고추장, 고춧가루 같은 어려운 오염도 쉽게 제거되어 매일같이 사용하는데 전혀 불편함이 없습니다.한 달 동안의 사용 후기를 요약하자면, 이제 저희 가정에서는 이 식기세척기 없이는 생활하기 힘들 것 같습니다. 다른 분들께도 강력하게 추천드립니다. 정말 만족스러운 제품입니다!

Sentence (English): We hadn't planned on replacing our existing dishwasher as it worked well and was very quietly.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We hadn't planned on replacing our existing dishwasher as it worked well and was very quietly. However when we got our new Samsung Slide in Induction stove and new Samsung over the range Microwave the salesman also asked us if we wanted to replace our dishwasher? He showed us the new Samsung dishwasher and that it was top of the line for a very good price we decided to get the dishwasher as well. I'm so glad we did as it has better features (including a top third rack for silverware) and it's even quieter and much more efficient than the old one. The "Auto Cycle" determines how much washing is required and adjusts the cycle times automatically. Sentence (English): So far the dishwasher is great.
Comments (English): [ The dishwasher is great, install concerns ] || ---------------- || So far the dishwasher is great. It's very quiet and did a good job cleaning everything even on the 60 minute cycle. I have concerns about the installation however. When the installers arrived and took a look, they stated I would need to pay an additional $200 for a GFCI outlet. This didn't make sense to me as the old dishwasher was already on a GFCI circuit being in the kitchen. They stated the old dishwasher was hardwired, I have no way to verify this was true or not. This left me in a position where if I didn't pay them $200, I would be left with a dishwasher on the floor taking up space that was not installed, even though they said I could get someone else to do it if I chose. Which would mean I had a dishwasher I couldn't use and would have to pay someone else to also do the installation. For this reason I feel like I was taken advantage of by the installers, as I didn't really have an option, despite them saying I did. I would have thought this would be part of the Costco installation/supplies. I also don't know if $200 was a fair price for this GFCI outlet I allegedly needed.

Sentence (English): We bought in September of 2020 and installed in October 2020.
Comments (English): [ Can you love a dishwasher- why yes you can! ] || ---------------- || We bought in September of 2020 and installed in October 2020. I picked this dishwasher for its noise rating. When you turn it on, you have to put your ear to it to tell if it has turned on- it is that quiet. We have an open kitchen to the family room where we watch TV, the kids and dog are constantly, etc., and we didn't want to have more background noise of the washer on top of all that. The 3 racks are a game changer- I took the utensil bins out and it never came back in! You can load sooooo much in this thing. We use the top 3rd rack for all the utensils. We are a family where there are always reusable water bottles to wash due to sports. We've loaded them on the bottom, put the lids in the middle row, and have no issues with them falling over or flipping in the cycles. My husband is a pre-washer/rinser and usually does a light scrub to the plates before he loads them. I am not a pre-washer, though I might hold a very dirty plate under a running faucet to get the big stuff off, but that is it. I have put this thing to the test, and everything has come out clean (you do have to choose the right cycle for the dirt load! ). The one con I have is that our wonderful machine just died in August, after not even 3 years of use (heavy use of at least 3 runs a week). We purchased the extended warranty through Home Depot, and we called and had Samsung come out to repair. After 2 attempts and some new parts, it was deemed unrepairable by Samsung. It would not actually start any cycle, but just stayed showing the same countdown time left the entire time. Everything is controlled by an internal computer on these appliance now, so I think that was the issue. Samsung was helpful and gave me a prorated refund based on my initial cost, and the HD extended warranty is covering the balance up to my full purchase price. I love everything about this machine, and despite ours breaking, I will be buying another one of the same model. I was so happy to find that it is still being manufactured! Hope you all find this helpful.

Sentence (English): This is a review of bestbuy's return/refurb documentation as much as of the actual item.
Comments (English): [ Documentation Fail, Machine Unusable ] || ---------------- || This is a review of Best Buy's return/refurb documentation as much as of the actual item. While our experience was abysmal with this one, it is unclear how much of that was due to misuse prior to our purchase. We found this dishwasher marked as a floor model, unused, and steeply discounted. We asked to verify that it had not been previously used and returned, and the store rep affirmed the only documentation on file was that it was a floor model. So, we purchased it. Fast forward to installation - what should have been an hour's operation, tops, turned into a full weekend of tripped breaker shutoffs, interrupted test cycles, filter cleaning that revealed it was clearly used (and not just a couple of loads, mind you - we had to scrub that filter), and headache. We ultimately could not make this dishwasher complete a full cycle without tripping and resetting the breaker, and we found a different (actually unused) floor model elsewhere that did install simply and run perfectly. Kudos to Best Buy for their return policy, as they did accept the machine's return easily, but not for their documentation on floor models and used products.

Comments (English): [ Buy a countertop dishwasher from Samsung ] || ---------------- || Total score: 4.8/5 points 1. Price: I like that I can buy it a little cheaper than the official website because I am a Wow member. 2. Design: Needless to say, it is neat and pretty. The volume is a little bigger than I thought, but it holds enough dishes, which is good~ 3. Function & cleaning power: There are various modes, and the reservation setting function seems useful! When installing: My house has a marble top, so I couldn't drill a hole, so I installed it by connecting it to the hole in the sink detergent dispenser! (Thank goodness) The hose sticks out toward the sink, but it doesn't bother me that much~ I was relieved that a Samsung employee came and installed it^^ 5. They gave me a coupon for a dishwasher detergent (Ecober), so I think I can buy it cheaper later! I already bought the P*sh product though. ^^;;

Sentence (English): We replaced our over 20 year old Bosch dishwasher with the Bosch 500 as we were very happy with the performance of the old one.
Comments (English): We replaced our over 20 year old Bosch dishwasher with the Bosch 500 as we were very happy with the performance of the old one. First the good - the 500 does a great job at cleaning all the dishes, pots and utensils. Everything comes out looking spotless and we love the air dry option where the dishwasher door opens automatically to help thoroughly dry the items. Now the bad - installation directions were not the best and you had to scan url to get links to videos with no sound or clear directions. But the worse thing about the 500 was the cheap plastic levelers now used by Bosch. Very difficult to turn the levelers having to use a flathead screw driver on tiny notches around the bottom. These notches easily stripped as I was trying to raise unit and was only able to turn them a quarter turn at a time - levelers would not spin using only your hand even with no weight on them. My old Bosch had metal levelers that spun very easily by hand with hardly any effort which made leveling the unit so much easier. Very disappointed in Bosch cheaping out like that. Had I known this prior to purchase it would have been a game killer and I would have looked at other brands. Finally, surprised there is no Bosch brand marking on the outside of the unit.
